annotations.text:
WAYPOINT — FULL LIGHT AND DARK THEMES. Click straight into the frames.

Light: neutral ground, white cards, and the teal header on Home that the page rises over.
Dark: unchanged. Every frame has a dark chip, so any of them can be flipped.

Working: tabs, spaces and places, Add a place (search, pin drop, tags, TikTok analysis, destinations), Create space (photo or emoji, icon, name, invite link), memories and filters, saved addresses, change password, English / العربية.

Not shown: the invite-link error state and the real share sheet (Share is a no-op). The invite link is a placeholder while the product name and domain are undecided. Change password has no backend endpoint yet.
